thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we should do a targeted noise sweep this week and lock down paging. main items: reduce dup 502 alerts, adjust cpu autoscale threshold alerts, add a 5m dedupe window, and tighten paging policy. propose owners below. pls ack and share ETAs. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b-example :spiral_calendar:
Simon: acked. I can take alert rules + dedupe windows. planning to push changes to prometheus rules by Thu COB. :thumbsup:
Leah: I’ll handle paging policy and escalation matrix. want to limit pages to severity=critical OR sustained incidents > 10m. I’ll draft new policy by Friday.
Devon: I’ll update the runbooks to reflect the dedupe behavior + add an ops play for 502 bursts. ETA next Wed.
Sam (SRE): small note — we should also add a metric-based pre-aggregation for 502s so spikes from a single upstream host don't flood rules. low-effort change, I can pair with Simon.
Simon: rough prometheus snippet I plan to apply (will dry-run in staging):
```
alert: HighOutbound502Rate
expr: increase(http_responses{status=~"5..",route!="/healthz"}[5m]) > 50
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "5m"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/502-burst"
```
Adding `for` and `dedupe_window` should cut the noise from brief spikes.
Maya: good. for paging, Leah — propose policy text so we can attach to alerts, e.g. `page: true` only when `severity=critical` or `for >= 10m`. also add a suppression rule for deploy windows.
Leah: yep — will add `suppress_during` tags and an explicit `no_page` label for low-severity. draft will include a small matrix (who to page at 3am vs 9am).
alert-bot: automated note: recent incident pattern shows 12/30 502 spikes last 14 days; top source: integration-x. See chart: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/502-bursts
Devon: can we add an actionable item to the postmortem tracker? I created GH issue #842 to track runbook + paging policy work. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/842
Maya: assigning items here so we don't drop them — please confirm ownership and final ETA by EOD tomorrow. Action items:
- Simon: update prometheus rules + add dedupe_window (due: Thu COB)
- Leah: publish paging policy + suppression rules (due: Fri COB)
- Devon: runbook updates + ops play (due: next Wed)
- Sam: pre-aggregation metric change + staging test (due: Thu COB)
Simon: acked, tagging PR when ready.
Leah: acked, will post policy to #eng-oncall when done.
Devon: acked, added steps and troubleshooting checklist to issue #842.
Sam (SRE): acked, will run loadtest tomorrow to validate.
Maya: thanks all. I’ll add these to the postmortem follow-up doc and set weekly check-ins until closed. if anyone hits blockers, ping me or @pagerduty. :lock:
